text: Bitcoin is outpacing Ethereum with a 1.4% gain versus 0.6%, suggesting selective strength in the largest asset while altcoins lag, with BNB and SOL nearly flat. The Fear & Greed index at 29 indicates persistent bearish sentiment that has worsened over the past week, despite modest price support. Bitcoin's dominance holding steady near 57% combined with $62B in daily volume reflects cautious positioning rather than conviction—traders appear to be holding core positions without committing fresh capital.
